title: A decision of a person: a criterion passed or not applicable for a scope
description: One line of decisions.jsonl in the results folder. The decision is void for a page whose content changed since the decision, see PLAN.md section 7.2.

scope.description: The pages of the decision, by path, each with the content hash of the page at the time of the decision. A template scope records the pages of the template at that time.

pages.description: The path of each page, with its content hash, or an empty string when the hash is not known.
